abstract: The Convergence Dividend is a flagship economic publication within the H Heuristics Polycrisis Resilience Series, based on the concept developed by Hunter Hughes, Founder of H Heuristics (https://polycrisisresilience.hheuristics.com/).

keyFindings.title: The Convergence Dividend proves that sustainable development in emerging economies generates mutually reinforcing returns extending far beyond GDP growth—lifting the Multidimensional Dividend Index (2025=100) to 228 by 2050 and 440 by 2100 (versus 205 for GDP-Only Growth).

Across seven core pathways—clean-tech diffusion, digital infrastructure, human capital, clean energy, productive infrastructure, climate adaptation, and institutional strengthening— 25-year social benefit-cost ratios reach 9.8x–11.8x (versus 1.5x for reactive crisis aid).
By 2050, emerging economies capture $17.2T/yr in multidimensional returns ($6.2T economic, $4.1T health/clean air, $3.6T education/digital, $3.3T climate resilience), scaling to $39.0T/yr by 2100.
Synchronized deployment slashes urban PM2.5 by 68–84%, cuts electricity costs by 42–54%, and expands regional output by +49% to +95% above baseline drift across Africa, Asia, MENA, and LatAm.
